free_tier.stated: 'New signups receive $400 to spend during their first 30 days.' The documentation adds 'Your free credit expires 30 days after you receive it.'

retention.stated: the credit expires 30 days after it is received, or when it is spent, whichever comes first

limits_note: the 60-day figure recorded earlier is contradicted by both the signup page and the documentation, which state 30 days

reliability_note: USD 400 in credit, and it expires 30 days after it is received; the credit is denominated in dollars rather than bytes. Kafka is append-only with retention, so the balance is not a storage quota.
